title: The judges of Pumbedita
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5), the designation refers to Rav Pappa bar Shmuel. The judges are also mentioned in [Ketubot 80a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.80a.3).[^1]

notes.text: The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3f/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._I._1910.pdf#page=365) has the heading and the patronymic bar, both omitted in the supplied transcription. The singular in Sanhedrin refers to Rav Pappa bar Shmuel. Ketubot uses the collective designation without naming the judges individually.
